newsitem.title: USA: North East Insurance gets A.M. Best upgrade.
newsitem.headline: North East Insurance gets A.M. Best upgrade.

text.p: North East Insurance Co said Wednesday its A.M. Best rating was upgraded to a B- from a D.

"This five level rating upgrade is a significant milestone for the company." said president and chief executive Robert Schatz. "We have been working towards this goal for a number of years, and it marks concrete reinforcement of our substantial progress. Further, the new rating assignment will have a profound impact on the company's ability to provide additional products and services through its agency force."
